title: Facebook Page Posts & Comments Scraper input
description: Private cost-controlled fork for Facebook page monitoring. Supports hard maxPosts, known-post overlap stopping, exact timestamp fallback, and posts/comments scraping.

pageOrUrl.title: Page, profile, group, or post URL
pageOrUrl.description: Facebook Page/profile handle, group URL, or direct post URL.

maxPosts.title: Hard maximum posts
maxPosts.description: Absolute ceiling for feed posts returned by this private fork. Monitoring stops earlier when a known post or stopAfterTime boundary is reached.

stopPostIds.title: Known post IDs to stop on
stopPostIds.description: Previously stored Facebook post IDs, newest first. The Actor stops immediately after encountering the first matching ID and includes that post as one overlap.

stopAfterTime.title: Exact previous-run timestamp fallback
stopAfterTime.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. If no stopPostId is encountered, stop after including the first post at or before this exact timestamp. Do not combine with date filters.

profile.title: Policy profile
profile.description: default = comments/replies; tops_only = no replies; full_replies = always fetch replies.

afterDate.title: Posts on or after
afterDate.description: Legacy calendar-date filter. Do not combine with stopPostIds or stopAfterTime.

postsOnly.title: Posts only
postsOnly.description: Discover posts and skip comment/reply scraping.

replyFbCap.title: Reply cap
replyFbCap.description: Fetch replies only when Facebook comment_count is below this. 0 = tops only.

maxComments.title: Max comments per post
maxComments.description: Maximum top-level comments per post. Leave empty for no limit.

minIntervalSec.title: Min interval seconds
minIntervalSec.description: Pause between comment pages, per worker.

megaThreshold.title: Mega threshold
megaThreshold.description: Pin the heaviest post to a dedicated worker when set.
